Figure 4: Overview of the main experimental results. Panel (a) shows that the Query Agent achieves comparable exact-value accuracy to Direct LLM while using fewer query-stage tokens; its accuracy axis is explicitly zoomed to 97.5–98.5%. Panel (b) reports absolute Multi-Intent Coverage and Multiset Jaccard scores without an external structured-output baseline. Panels (c)–(d) report mean automatic Trustworthiness, Transparency, and Actionability scores on a 1–5 scale. The figure presents observed averages and does not imply statistical significance.

Figure 1: Overview of the task-oriented multi-agent framework. A composite query is decomposed into isolated intents and typed tasks with explicit dependencies. Specialized agents execute the tasks, and the terminal intent results are aggregated into the final response.
